scientific_integrity: All universal statements are proven by explicit finite-state transition identities and a factorial-moment inequality. Finite checks corroborate but are not treated as infinite proofs. Historical priority and independent validation are not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Covers only the uniform-feasible-edge greedy algorithm on complete graphs with a fixed perfect matching removed.
Does not determine sharp second-order correction.
The original 1991 algorithm paper full text could not be inspected; historical priority unresolved.
No independent scientific audit has been performed.
title: A sharp three-quarter rare-failure law for greedy matching on cocktail-party graphs
